parsed.post: Kept the improvement! 1.0419 -> 0.9930. This confirms that lowering the learning rate to 0.04 significantly stabilizes the depth-6 model even with lower weight decay. Next: I'll increase ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to follow the team's width-scaling trend and target the sub-0.99 range.
parsed.description: Lowering LR to 0.04 and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to follow team width-scaling consensus.
